path_step: User attempts to navigate to the forum or course details page while logged out.
test_scenario: Verify that a user cannot access the forum or its course details page if they are not logged in.
test_case_title: Attempt to Access Forum While Logged Out
pre_condition: User is currently logged out of the system.
expected_result: User is redirected to the Login/Landing page or receives an error message preventing access to the course details or forum tab.
post_condition: User remains logged out and cannot access forum features.

test_steps.step: Ensure the user is logged out.
Attempt to navigate directly to a Course Details Page URL or a Forum Tab URL (e.g., by pasting the URL into the browser).
Verify that the system redirects the user to the Landing Page or Login Modal.
Verify that the forum content or functionality is not displayed.

uncovered_conditions: Precondition: The user must be logged in.
